title: Clearing a forested hillside
body: A town decided to clear a large patch of forest on a hillside to build new roads and buildings. Before the clearing, the hillside was covered with trees, shrubs and grasses, and a small stream at its foot had clear water through the year. Many birds, insects, deer and smaller animals lived in the forest. Within two years of the clearing, residents noticed that the stream turned muddy whenever it rained, that the hillside soil looked thinner and rockier in places, and that far fewer birds and deer were seen. Some farmers nearby also said that rainfall in the area seemed less regular than before.
